640   # Returns the battler representing the Pokémon at index idxParty in its party,
  641   # on the same side as a battler with battler index of idxBattlerOther.
  642   def pbFindBattler(idxParty, idxBattlerOther = 0)
  643     allSameSideBattlers(idxBattlerOther).each { |b| return b if b.pokemonIndex == idxParty }
  644     return nil
  645   end

  647   # Only used for Wish, as the Wishing Pokémon will no longer be in battle.
  648   def pbThisEx(idxBattler, idxParty)
  649     party = pbParty(idxBattler)
  650     if opposes?(idxBattler)
  651       return _INTL("The opposing {1}", party[idxParty].name) if trainerBattle?
  652       return _INTL("The wild {1}", party[idxParty].name)
  653     end
  654     return _INTL("The ally {1}", party[idxParty].name) if !pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler)
  655     return party[idxParty].name
  656   end

  658   def pbSetSeen(battler)
  659     return if !battler || !@internalBattle
  660     if battler.is_a?(Battler)
  661       pbPlayer.pokedex.register(battler.displaySpecies, battler.displayGender,
  662                                 battler.displayForm, battler.shiny?)
  663     else
  664       pbPlayer.pokedex.register(battler)
  665     end
  666   end

  668   def pbSetCaught(battler)
  669     return if !battler || !@internalBattle
  670     if battler.is_a?(Battler)
  671       pbPlayer.pokedex.register_caught(battler.displaySpecies)
  672     else
  673       pbPlayer.pokedex.register_caught(battler.species)
  674     end
  675   end
